                                          Generative variations
                                          
        
                                          A model produces multiple candidate outputs for one brief so a person can compare, pick, remix or regenerate along chosen dimensions.
                                          
      
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Anatomy
                                          • Brief — The shared prompt or constraints
                                          • Candidate — One generated option
                                          • Grid or strip — How candidates are compared
                                          • Controls — Vary, remix, upscale, apply
                                          
    
                                          Design space
                                          Candidate representation content
                                          What does each variation show?
                                          representation Representation one
                                          Set composition composition
                                          How do candidates relate to the brief and each other?
                                          setForm Set form one
                                          Comparison layout layout
                                          How are variations arranged for choice?
                                          layout Layout one
                                          Generation controls invocation
                                          How does the person request or steer the set?
                                          controls Controls many
                                          Selection flow flow
                                          How does choosing proceed after candidates appear?
                                          selection Selection one
                                          Provenance feedback feedback
                                          How are origin and parameters shown on candidates?
                                          feedback Feedback many
                                          
    
                                          Configure
                                          
    
                                          In the wild
                                          Parameters, seeds and remix strength are commonly tweaked; grid size less often.
                                          • Midjourney — Parameters, remix, vary region
                                          • Canva — Magic Studio regenerate
                                          • ChatGPT — Regenerate / try again
                                          
    
                                          Techniques · signature Vary along named dimensions
                                          • Vary along named dimensions (Set composition) — Expose axes (style, layout, tone) so the grid is a small design space, not an opaque shuffle.
                                          • Breed from winners · AI (Generation controls) — Selecting candidates feeds a next generation with locked and free attributes made visible.
                                          • Keep the brief beside the grid (Comparison layout) — Show the editable brief and parameters while comparing so regeneration does not lose intent.
                                          
    
                                          Protocol
                                          Sample. Image generators, marketing copy tools, design assistants and alternative-UI generators.
                                          Unit. One generation set from one brief.
                                          
      
                                          Coded. 20 instances, 3 raters (fable, opus, sonnet), 3 rounds. κ 0.73 first pass → 0.95 final; all three agree on 82% → 97% of cells. 0 variations adopted of 0 proposed; 0 unresolved cells; 5 unobserved variations.
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Relations
                                          
    
                                          Usage
                                          • People upscale then still ask for variations of the winner
                                          
    
                                          Questions
                                          • Which axes should be user-named versus inferred from the brief?

                                          Inline suggestion
                                          
        
                                          Model-proposed continuation or edit shown inside the artifact at the caret or selection, accepted, cycled or dismissed without leaving the editor.
                                          
      
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Anatomy
                                          • Ghost text — The proposed insertion
                                          • Caret context — What the model conditioned on
                                          • Accept control — Keyboard or click to take it
                                          • Alternative cycle — Other proposals
                                          
    
                                          Design space
                                          Suggestion content content
                                          What form does the proposal take?
                                          content Content one
                                          Where it appears layout
                                          How is the suggestion placed relative to the artifact?
                                          placement Placement one
                                          Triggering invocation
                                          What brings a suggestion up?
                                          trigger Trigger many
                                          Acceptance flow flow
                                          How are proposals taken, varied or refused?
                                          acceptFlow Accept flow one
                                          
      
    
                                          Suggestion initiative initiative
                                          How assertive is the model?
                                          initiative Initiative one
                                          Confidence feedback feedback
                                          How is suggestion quality or origin shown?
                                          feedback Feedback many
                                          
    
                                          Configure
                                          
    
                                          In the wild
                                          Enablement, languages and keybindings are commonly customized; ghost styling rarely.
                                          • VS Code Copilot — Enable per-language; keybindings
                                          • Cursor — Tab modes and models
                                          • Gmail — Smart Compose on/off
                                          
    
                                          Techniques · signature Partial accept
                                          • Partial accept (Acceptance flow) — Allow word- or hunk-level acceptance so people keep control when only part of the ghost is right.
                                          • Suggest only under caret policy (Suggestion initiative) — Expose when suggestions fire (always, on pause, on shortcut) as a first-class preference.
                                          • Condition on a selection brief · AI (Triggering) — For selection edits, show the short brief the model used and let it be edited before regenerating.
                                          
    
                                          Protocol
                                          Sample. IDEs, writing editors and design tools with caret-level AI.
                                          Unit. One inline proposal episode at a caret or selection.
                                          
      
                                          Coded. 20 instances, 3 raters (fable, opus, sonnet), 3 rounds. κ 0.77 first pass → 0.96 final; all three agree on 88% → 97% of cells. 1 variation adopted of 1 proposed; 0 unresolved cells; 9 unobserved variations.
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Relations
                                          
    
                                          Usage
                                          • Developers tab-accept then immediately edit, treating suggestions as clay
                                          
    
                                          Questions
                                          • How should inline suggestions disclose training-data risk without killing flow?

                                          AI provenance
                                          
        
                                          Visible markers of what a model produced, from which sources or tools, so a person can judge trust, reuse and responsibility.
                                          
      
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Anatomy
                                          • Badge — That something is AI-involved
                                          • Source list — Citations or tools used
                                          • Detail — Expanded provenance
                                          • Action — Inspect, copy or report
                                          
    
                                          Design space
                                          What is disclosed content
                                          What provenance facts are shown?
                                          disclosure Disclosure many
                                          
      
    
                                          Provenance placement layout
                                          Where do disclosure cues sit?
                                          placement Placement one
                                          Inspecting provenance invocation
                                          How does a person open the full trail?
                                          openBy Open by many
                                          Trust feedback feedback
                                          How is uncertainty or risk communicated?
                                          trustCues Trust cues many
                                          
      
    
                                          
    
                                          Configure
                                          
    
                                          In the wild
                                          Citation density sometimes adjustable; disclosure chrome rarely user-designed.
                                          • Perplexity — Source focus modes
                                          • ChatGPT — Show more / sources where offered
                                          • Google Docs — Help me write disclosure
                                          
    
                                          Techniques · signature Claim-linked citations
                                          • Claim-linked citations (What is disclosed) — Attach sources to spans or claims, not only to the whole reply.
                                          • Provenance travels on copy (Inspecting provenance) — Copied AI output optionally carries a compact provenance stub into the destination.
                                          • Flag unsupported claims · AI (Trust feedback) — Highlight statements that lack retrieval or tool support before acceptance.
                                          
    
                                          Protocol
                                          Sample. Answer engines, chat replies, generated docs and agent traces.
                                          Unit. One provenance record for one AI-produced span or object.
                                          
      
                                          Coded. 20 instances, 3 raters (fable, opus, sonnet), 3 rounds. κ 0.72 first pass → 0.93 final; all three agree on 89% → 96% of cells. 2 variations adopted of 2 proposed; 0 unresolved cells; 5 unobserved variations.
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Relations
                                          
    
                                          Usage
                                          • People click sources only when stakes are high
                                          
    
                                          Questions
                                          • What provenance must survive export into Word, Figma or Git?

                                          Twelve dimension families
                                          
        
                                          Every dimension in every pattern is tagged with exactly one family. Content, Composition and Layout come from CHI ’25; the rest generalize Meridian and the study.
                                          
        
                                          
  
                                          01
                                          
  
                                          Content
                                          
  
                                          What information each component shows, and how it is abstracted from the underlying item: visually, semantically or computationally.
                                          
  
                                          What is shown where, and in what form?
                                          
  
                                          94 entries · CHI '25 content analysis (dimension 1 of 3)
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          02
                                          
  
                                          Composition
                                          
  
                                          How multiple instances and components relate: cardinality, nesting, recursion, linking and synchronization.
                                          
  
                                          How do the parts connect?
                                          
  
                                          57 entries · CHI '25 content analysis (dimension 2 of 3)
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          03
                                          
  
                                          Layout
                                          
  
                                          The spatial arrangement of components, and of items inside them.
                                          
  
                                          Where do the parts sit?
                                          
  
                                          87 entries · CHI '25 content analysis (dimension 3 of 3)
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          04
                                          
  
                                          Invocation
                                          
  
                                          How a component is summoned and dismissed: the trigger, the entry point, and the way back.
                                          
  
                                          What brings it up, and from where?
                                          
  
                                          67 entries · Meridian openBy / openFrom; the Click, Hover and Back annotations in CHI '25 Fig. 3; study participant P6
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          05
                                          
  
                                          Flow
                                          
  
                                          Progression through steps or states: linear, branching, free or resumable, and the rules for moving between them.
                                          
  
                                          In what order, and under what rules?
                                          
  
                                          29 entries · Generalized
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          06
                                          
  
                                          Lifecycle
                                          
  
                                          Time-bound behaviour: when something appears, how long it persists, how it expires and how it updates live.
                                          
  
                                          When does it appear, change and go away?
                                          
  
                                          52 entries · Generalized
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          07
                                          
  
                                          Initiative
                                          
  
                                          Who acts: the person, the system or an AI, and how control is handed between them.
                                          
  
                                          Who decides, and who does the work?
                                          
  
                                          49 entries · Generalized; anticipated by AI-assisted Fluid Attributes (CHI '25 §4.1.3)
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          08
                                          
  
                                          Feedback
                                          
  
                                          How state, progress, validation, consequence and error are expressed back to the person.
                                          
  
                                          How does the person know what happened?
                                          
  
                                          57 entries · Generalized
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          09
                                          
  
                                          Scope
                                          
  
                                          The unit an operation or attribute applies to: an item, a selection, a group, a whole collection, or everything.
                                          
  
                                          What does it apply to?
                                          
  
                                          57 entries · CHI '25 study: participants P6, P10 and P12 wanted attributes about the whole collection, not only each item
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          10
                                          
  
                                          Encoding
                                          
  
                                          How values map to visual variables and marks: position, size, colour, shape, motion.
                                          
  
                                          How do values become visuals?
                                          
  
                                          20 entries · Generalized from CHI '25 Fig. 11, where attributes invoke a representation (scatter plot, colour space)
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          11
                                          
  
                                          Collaboration
                                          
  
                                          Presence, authorship, permission and concurrency when more than one person touches the same thing.
                                          
  
                                          Who else is here, and what may they do?
                                          
  
                                          19 entries · Generalized; anticipated by shared abstractions (CHI '25 §8.3)
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          12
                                          
  
                                          Adaptation
                                          
  
                                          How the pattern changes with density, screen size, platform, input modality or the person’s ability.
                                          
  
                                          How does it change with context?
                                          
  
                                          21 entries · Generalized from the CHI '25 mobile application (§5.1.5) and Meridian’s responsive-spec discussion (§7)
                                          

                                          
      
                                          
      
                                          
        
                                          The ten-stage method
                                          
        
                                          The design space of a pattern is simultaneously (a) its codebook for analysis, (b) its customization surface for end users, and (c) its generation target for GenUI. One artifact, three readings. Meridian made (b) and (c) literal for overview–detail by formalizing the space as a specification; the atlas extends that to every pattern.
                                          
        
                                          
  
                                          1
                                          
  
                                          
    
                                          Scope the pattern
                                          
    
                                          Say what the pattern is made of, what it is also called, and what it is not.
                                          
    
                                          
      
                                          ODI
                                          Two views, overview and detail view (CHI §2.1), later three: overview, item view and detail view (UIST §2.1). Aliases master–detail and director–detail. Focus+context fenced off as a related but distinct pattern.
                                          
      
                                          Atlas
                                          Every entry names its components with one-line roles, its aliases, its neighbors, its level of abstraction and its home archetype.
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Automatable in this build
                                          
  
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          2
                                          
  
                                          
    
                                          Frame analysis questions
                                          
    
                                          Fix what the content analysis is looking for before looking.
                                          
    
                                          
      
                                          ODI
                                          Q1 What arrangements exist in the wild? Q2 What information is presented in each view? Q3 What is already customizable by end users? (CHI §3)
                                          
      
                                          Atlas
                                          The same three questions, specialized to each pattern’s own components. Generated from the entry, so they never drift from it.
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Automatable in this build
                                          
  
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          3
                                          
  
                                          
    
                                          Sample instances
                                          
    
                                          Collect a diverse, representative set of real instances, with a unit of analysis defined so that one instance is one countable thing.
                                          
    
                                          
      
                                          ODI
                                          Four frames: Similarweb top 50 US sites; Semrush top 5 in each of 33 categories; 20 random WordPress showcase sites; 20 random Awwwards 2024 Sites of the Year. After de-duplication, 156 sites and 303 instances. Unit: one overview→detail relationship, so a page with two overviews counts twice (CHI §3.1.1).
                                          
      
                                          Atlas
                                          A written sampling frame and unit of analysis per pattern, ready to execute. Not executed.
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Needs people
                                          
  
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          4
                                          
  
                                          
    
                                          Code to saturation
                                          
    
                                          Turn instances into a codebook that more than one person applies the same way, and stop when new instances stop teaching anything.
                                          
    
                                          
      
                                          ODI
                                          Three authors independently coded 20 random instances and clustered their categories into an initial codebook. Two authors coded 20 more: 94.8% agreement (Cohen’s κ), then resolved differences. One author continued in random batches of 20, with both authors reviewing new dimensions after each batch. Stopped when three consecutive rounds added no dimension or variation; 120 instances coded in total (CHI §3.1.2).
                                          
      
                                          Atlas
                                          Each design space is a seed codebook. Saturation is recorded as not run for every pattern except overview–detail.
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Needs people
                                          
  
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          5
                                          
  
                                          
    
                                          Construct the design space
                                          
    
                                          Organize the codebook into dimensions, sub-dimensions and variations, each variation anchored to a real exemplar.
                                          
    
                                          
      
                                          ODI
                                          Content (attribute placement; visual, semantic and computational abstraction), Composition (relationships; recursion), Layout (overview–detail arrangement; overview layout; detail multiplicity). Figure 3.
                                          
      
                                          Atlas
                                          Dimensions → sub-dimensions → variations for every entry. Every dimension is tagged with one of twelve families, so the spaces can be compared with each other.
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Automatable in this build
                                          
  
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          6
                                          
  
                                          
    
                                          Audit existing customizability
                                          
    
                                          Measure how much of the space end users can already reach, dimension by dimension.
                                          
    
                                          
      
                                          ODI
                                          13 of 156 sites (8.33%) offered any overview–detail customization: content 4 (2.56%), composition 0 (0%), layout 12 (7.69%). Craigslist offered the most, with five overview layouts and three overview–detail layouts; eBay let users toggle six attributes (CHI §3.3).
                                          
      
                                          Atlas
                                          A desk audit of customization features known in shipping products, plus an estimated 0–3 score. Measured shares exist only for overview–detail.
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Partly needs people
                                          
  
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          7
                                          
  
                                          
    
                                          Design malleability techniques
                                          
    
                                          Give end users a way to move along each dimension. The richest dimension gets a new technique; the others get familiar controls.
                                          
    
                                          
      
                                          ODI
                                          Content → Fluid Attributes: surface and hide attributes across views; sort and filter by any attribute; AI query, generation, reformatting and filling of missing values. Composition and layout → dropdown menus and tabbed overviews. Attributes invoke representations: select Price and Feedback Score for a scatter plot (CHI §4).
                                          
      
                                          Atlas
                                          Per-dimension techniques for every entry, one named signature technique, and AI-assisted variants flagged.
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Automatable in this build
                                          
  
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          8
                                          
  
                                          
    
                                          Formalize a specification
                                          
    
                                          Express any point in the design space, and any customization, as a declarative document shared by designers, developers, end users and models.
                                          
    
                                          
      
                                          ODI
                                          Meridian: dataBinding (attributes with value, type, roles, groups, conditions and transforms) decoupled from views (overviews with type, itemView, shown and hidden attributes, bindingId; detailViews with openIn, openFrom, openBy; recursion by id), plus a malleability block per dimension (UIST §3).
                                          
      
                                          Atlas
                                          A shared grammar (binding, config, compose, malleability) and a per-pattern JSON Schema derived mechanically: each sub-dimension becomes a property whose values are its variations.
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Automatable in this build
                                          
  
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          9
                                          
  
                                          
    
                                          Demonstrate across domains and stakeholders
                                          
    
                                          Show the space generalizes beyond the context it was found in, and that each stakeholder can act on it with familiar tools.
                                          
    
                                          
      
                                          ODI
                                          Five applications: shopping, hotels, email, live articles, mobile food delivery (CHI §5). End users: customization widgets, spec exchange, semantic zoom, direct manipulation mapped to spec moves, AI generation. Developers: a package reproducing AT&T, Marca and Merriam-Webster pages. Designers: a no-code builder with a Design Space grid and usage-driven defaults (UIST §4–6).
                                          
      
                                          Atlas
                                          Domain lists and techniques for every entry. Worked GenUI instance specs in genui/examples. The atlas document itself is a malleable overview–detail interface, a demonstration in its own right.
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Automatable in this build
                                          
  
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          10
                                          
  
                                          
    
                                          Compose real screens, and count what cannot be said
                                          
    
                                          Test the grammar rather than the codebook. Freeze it, write eight real interfaces in it, make each screen declare the things it must be able to state, and treat every statement with no construct as a hole. Fill the holes, rewrite the screens that opened them, and go again.
                                          
    
                                          
      
                                          ODI
                                          Implicit in CHI '25: the five applications were written against one spec, and the spec's limitations section — imprecise arrangement, index conditions, no cross-item constraints — is exactly this stage's output, arrived at by building rather than by measuring.
                                          
      
                                          Atlas
                                          Five rounds of eight screens, forty in all, from a photo library to a cash machine. 275 claims, 29 holes, and five revisions that took the grammar from one relation to fourteen and from 5 constructs to 52; four holes are left open and named. Every spec validates against the published schema and resolves against the corpus, so an example cannot drift from the codebook it illustrates. Reported in Writing Screens.mrbl.
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Automatable in this build
                                          
  
                                          

                                          

                                          
  
                                          11
                                          
  
                                          
    
                                          Evaluate and iterate
                                          
    
                                          Watch people use the malleable pattern, then feed what they did, and failed to do, back into the space and the spec.
                                          
    
                                          
      
                                          ODI
                                          Design probes, N=12. Diverse configurations from identical starting points; hoarders vs minimalists; customizing at the start vs throughout; surface-then-sort and surface-then-filter; multiple overviews used to structure sub-tasks. Unmet: hover invocation and collection-level attributes (CHI §6–7). Spec limitations: imprecise arrangement, index-conditional attributes, a variable number of views (UIST §5.4).
                                          
      
                                          Atlas
                                          Hypothesized usage patterns and open questions per entry, phrased so that a probe study can test them.
                                          
    
                                          
    
                                          Needs people
